panels.description: Higher of inbound and outbound utilization for the ten busiest interfaces.

targets.expr:
topk(10,
  max by (job, switch, interface) (
    label_replace(
      100 * rate(arista_interface_in_octets_total{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch"}[5m]) * 8
        / on(job, switch, interface)
          arista_interface_speed_bits_per_second{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch"},
      "direction", "in", "interface", ".*"
    )
    or
    label_replace(
      100 * rate(arista_interface_out_octets_total{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch"}[5m]) * 8
        / on(job, switch, interface)
          arista_interface_speed_bits_per_second{job=~"$job",switch=~"$switch"},
      "direction", "out", "interface", ".*"
    )
  )
)
